mutants.what: R-3 link set on the real tree (v8-arch-gyo2-batch4-followups, README rule 4: positive control): the rollback Module's registered row depends on one more Module (json, a row before rollback, so the register's order check lets it through). Only gyo_expect_links on gyo_rollback stops it; no other check pins the rollback Module's links

R-3: a directory configured after tests/common/rollback (tests/common/authority) links GYO::Authority into gyo_rollback, the rollback Module knowing authority (v8-arch-gyo2-batch4-followups). Only the DEFER of the gyo_rollback check sees a link added later from another directory, and it is the one way to link authority into rollback that the register (authority comes later) and O6 (scans engine/ only) leave open. The \S* allows CMake's directory scope markers that a link from another directory adds
mutants.replace:
target_link_libraries(gyo_authority_tests PRIVATE GYO::Authority gyo_test_support doctest::doctest)
